classification.difficultyReason: Find the missing rectangle height, scale both lengths and calculate the enlarged area.

content.prompt: Determine the area of the scaled rectangle.

spec.description: Unshaded similar rectangles, larger on the left, with corresponding horizontal width dimensions.
spec.mathematics: Large width 12 cm and area x cm²; small width 6 cm and area 15 cm². Heights are unspecified.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown area appear.

answer.worked:
The scale factor from the small rectangle to the large rectangle is $12\div6=2$.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Small height}&=15\div6=2.5\text{ cm}\\\text{Large height}&=2.5\times2=5\text{ cm}\\\text{Large area}&=12\times5=60\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$$
